figurative_meaning_en: To remain established or settled for a long period
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এই শহরে চেপে বসেছে, কোনোদিন যাবে না।
পুরনো বাড়িটা গ্রামে চেপে বসে আছে বহু বছর ধরে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has put down roots in this city and won't leave anytime soon.
The old house has been entrenched in the village for many years.
note: Idiom often used to describe long-term residency or attachment to a place.
